title: Retention Payoff Daily Accrual — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction
content:
## Daily accrual on a retention payoff — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

A retention payoff is the payoff case of a Borrower Voluntary Payoff requested by the borrower of record on a loan whose maturity case is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure. The per diem recorded on a retention payoff is the retention daily accrual: the amount by which the payoff grows for each day, which the statement and any late funds rely on.

**Scope of the per diem.** For a Borrower Voluntary Payoff requested by the borrower of record on a loan whose maturity case is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure, and only for such a payoff, the per diem is the retention daily accrual; every payoff case other than a retention payoff and the payoff case of an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record keeps its per diem as the loan balance on the statement date times the loan's note rate plus, for a HECM, the annual MIP rate, divided by the plan's per diem day count, rounded half up to the cent.

The per diem is recorded when the borrower of record asks for payoff terms on such a case, and the recorded per diem is the figure quoted to the borrower.

### Recording the daily accrual

**Capability.** The tool records the daily accrual (per diem) on a borrower's payoff case for a loan that has been called due. The case's daily accrual is replaced by the amount passed in; its status and every other figure on the case stay as they are, and the statement request and maturity case named are quoted back in the receipt.

**How it is invoked.** `record_payoff_daily_accrual_16b003bd` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `payoff_case_id` | the reference number of the payoff case, as returned by the payoff case lookup | identifier |
| `payoff_request_id` | the reference number of the payoff statement request on file that this write answers, as returned by the payoff submission lookup | identifier |
| `maturity_case_id` | the reference number of the loan's maturity case, as returned by the maturity case lookup | identifier |
| `per_diem_amount` | the daily accrual to record | USD with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A confirmation naming the payoff case, statement request and maturity case reference numbers and the daily accrual now recorded (USD, 2 decimal places); the words "daily accrual recorded" show the write completed. On success the case shows the new daily accrual. No other return or error is defined for this tool.
